name: viteTranslate
description: i18n for React + Vite with no translation keys: write text in your own language right in JSX. The plugin extracts it, syncs YAML tables, compiles ICU plurals and dates at build time, and lazy-loads each language. Optional LLM translation. 5 kB gzip runtime, zero dependencies.

paragraphs: A simpler translation workflow for React and Vite.

Write text naturally in JSX. viteTranslate extracts strings, keeps locale files in sync, and compiles translations as part of your Vite workflow. No hand-written keys. No separate extraction workflow. No extra runtime dependencies.

✅ native support · 🟡 partial support, official add-on or extra setup · ❌ not offered by the project. Documentation checked on October 10, 2026: Lingui 6, FormatJS (react-intl 12), i18next 26 + react-i18next 17.
